# Vi2nano Linux Workspace

This repository builds a personal Arch Linux desktop installation profile.

- Keep installer changes explicit, reviewable, and safe around disks.
- Preserve AMD-first Wayland support and add NVIDIA support without breaking AMD defaults.
- Keep Hyprland, Waybar, nwg-drawer, SDDM, LUKS2, Btrfs, and Snapper configuration aligned.
- Prefer small, reproducible shell scripts and document hardware assumptions.
- Test installer logic in a VM before using it on physical hardware.
